modified_source_notices: Each of the nine API-ported source files carries a prominent local-modification notice. The pinned upstream repository has no root NOTICE file.
scope: Primary-source probability, grid, locality and routing helpers and their dependency closure, with explicitly listed Lean 4.31 API ports only. Dyadic-displacement-only wrappers are not used to infer the geometric conclusion.
api_ports: Set.mem_ofPred_eq -> Set.mem_setOf_eq in imported modules. The host compiler does not provide the newer name; the replacement is the definitional set-membership simplifier.
Measurable.of_eval -> measurable_pi_iff.mpr in imported modules. The host compiler provides coordinatewise measurability under the older equivalent interface.
dite_eq_left -> dif_pos and dite_eq_right -> dif_neg in imported modules. These are the corresponding dependent-conditional reduction lemmas in Lean 4.31.
source_inspection: The pinned primary sources were inspected, and the retained dependency closure compiled on the host. The imported probability and union-bound assumptions were retired after their proofs compiled; the target's remaining assumption is the separately recorded original-window realization. Host Reviewer assessment remains outstanding.
build: Run verify.py --build-upstream before importing these local OAI modules. This does not fetch or build a second Mathlib workspace.
